CustomField.description: YoY Award Change as a percentage of the prior cycle award. The formula multiplies by 100 because a Percent formula field displays whatever it returns with a % sign - it does not scale the result. Blank when there is no prior cycle, either Amount is empty, or the prior award was zero.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Prior_Cycle_Grant__c), ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Prior_Cycle_Grant__r.Amount), Prior_Cycle_Grant__r.Amount = 0 ), NULL, (Amount - Prior_Cycle_Grant__r.Amount) / Prior_Cycle_Grant__r.Amount * 100 )
CustomField.label: YoY Award Change %
